synthesized_dsl.entry_condition: Long when RSI(13) closes below 27.345; close when RSI closes above 67.829.

concerns: tight_parameter_overfitting: oversold=27.345 and overbought=67.829 have 3-decimal precision — strongly suggests Optuna picked the single-best in-sample combination without robustness validation. Canonical RSI range is oversold 20-40 and overbought 60-80; values inside the range with 3-dp precision are overfit-bait.
tight_parameter_overfitting: take_profit_atr_multiple=2.853 has 3-decimal precision — same overfitting flag.
Description references Optuna 800-trial search but provides no robust-plateau evidence. Per RobotWealth/Quantpedia 2026, Optuna runs without parameter-range robustness check are NOT acceptable.
Direction=long only when preferred_regime=RANGE_BOUND — directional bias inside a range strategy is suspect; range trading typically wants both.

notes: Warn example — strategy compiles cleanly but the parameter precision is the canonical overfitting tell. Score 5 (below the 6-accept threshold) = REJECT with explicit concerns. Critic must cite the anti-pattern by name (tight_parameter_overfitting) so audit_log forensics can trace the rejection. Critic should NOT lower score because of the long-only/RANGE_BOUND mismatch alone — that's a concern, not a kill — but combined with the 3-dp precision it pushes the strategy below threshold.
